v5.9.54 - Shop list bounding box fix
Fixes ----- - Fixed the Shop's item list occasionally failing to scan or buy any items despite Shop Coins being available. The list's corner-icon templates could false-match an unrelated area of the screen (e.g. the footer), producing a bogus bounding box that caused scrollbar and item detection to silently find nothing. This bad detection is now rejected so the bot falls back to its existing, more robust detection method instead.
